# Banana bread

Use bananas with lots of brown spots — the riper, the sweeter.

## Ingredients
- 3 very ripe bananas, mashed
- 75 g melted butter
- 150 g sugar
- 1 egg, beaten
- 1 tsp vanilla
- 1 tsp baking soda, pinch of salt
- 190 g flour

## Method
1. Heat the oven to 175 °C and butter a loaf tin.
2. Mix the mashed bananas with the butter, then stir in sugar, egg and vanilla.
3. Sprinkle in baking soda and salt, then fold in the flour.
4. Bake for about 60 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
